content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers from Central Governments Services including all India Services (AIS) and organized Group 'A' Services, State Government Officers/ Officers of Union Territories/ PSUs/ Autonomous bodies/ Statutory bodies holding analogous post or with 5 years service in pay level 10 Experience: Holding analogous post on regular basis, or with 5 years of service in the post having Pay Level -10 as per the 7th CPC Pay matrix. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of receipt of application) Other conditions: Applicants must be relieved in the event of selection. Desirable: Possessing experience in industrial development, foreign trade, estate development and administration.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Department of Commerce Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications not received in the prescribed format, received after the last date, or without confidential reports and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay Level 11 as per the 7th CPC matrix; no rupee amount is printed. The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 03 years in case of DDC.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Department of Commerce Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Department of Commerce Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Development Commissioner (DDC).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Department of Commerce Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II) and send it to The Under Secretary (SEZ), Cabin No. 3001, 3rd Floor, Department of Commerce, Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi-110001, to reach by 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 11 as per 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers from Central Governments Services including all India Services (AIS) and organized Group 'A' Services, State Government Officers/ Officers of Union Territories/ PSUs/ Autonomous bodies/ Statutory bodies holding analogous post or with 5 years service in pay level 10.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be relieved in the event of selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not received in the prescribed format, received after the last date, or without confidential reports and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 03 years in case of DDC.
